5614ab535516126241ffa80a564f355a.overview: A team of allied saboteurs are assigned an impossible mission: infiltrate an impregnable Nazi-held island and destroy the two enormous long-range field guns that prevent the rescue of 2,000 trapped British soldiers.
5614ab535516126241ffa80a564f355a.tagline: The greatest high adventure ever filmed!

56261c82137d50094a41bbbcebf66ec0.overview: A waitress agrees to accompany an exotic dancer, her put-upon boyfriend, and her mysterious and domineering roommate on a road trip to Florida to seek their fortune at a high-end strip club.

5635f4291abb2fbe15d7c7b5e7caddc5.overview: Mike Brannon is a former war hero turned midget car racer. His ruthless racing tactics have made him successful but the fans consider him a villain and boo him mercilessly. Independent, beautiful reporter Regina Forbes tries to interview him but is put off by his gruff chauvinism, and when Brannon's daredevil tactics cause the death of a fellow driver, he finds himself a pariah in the sport thanks to her articles. When she finds him earning money as a barnstorming daredevil driver hoping for a comeback, they begin to become mutually attracted.
5635f4291abb2fbe15d7c7b5e7caddc5.tagline: CLARK GABLE - BARBARA STANWYCK - HE'S MISTER SPEED! SHE'S MISS SPITFIRE!

56421756de4daa2435f0a78ff1ac8eb4.overview: Pat Garrett is hired as a lawman on behalf of a group of wealthy New Mexico cattle barons to bring down his old friend Billy the Kid.
56421756de4daa2435f0a78ff1ac8eb4.tagline: Best of enemies. Deadliest of friends.

5646170000e4c0327b286bed2e494759.overview: In Imperial Russia, Anna, wife of the officer Karenin, goes to Moscow to visit her brother. On the way, she meets charming cavalry officer Vronsky, to whom she's immediately attracted. But in St. Petersburg’s high society, a relationship like this could destroy a woman’s reputation.
5646170000e4c0327b286bed2e494759.tagline: THESE TWO LOVED...and the world stood aghast!

564e31d6bde39634f3c3028c18c3158e.overview: A documentary capturing the creation of the album Junun inside Rajasthan’s 15th-century Mehrangarh Fort. Paul Thomas Anderson follows Jonny Greenwood, Shye Ben Tzur, Nigel Godrich, and the Rajasthan Express as they record a cross-cultural fusion of Indian, Israeli, and Western music.

5663754ecd275ffad16ad3901bbd7cc6.overview: Disciplined Italian composer Antonio Salieri becomes consumed by jealousy and resentment towards the hedonistic and remarkably talented young Salzburger composer Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
5663754ecd275ffad16ad3901bbd7cc6.tagline: The man... The music... The madness... The murder... The motion picture.

566c68471b31047aac3ce1b052bd21a2.overview: A 14-year-old video enthusiast obsessed with violent films decides to make one of his own and show it to his parents, with tragic results.

56777420b7d5182fae8a695108f71be4.overview: Boisterous gangster kingpin Bull Weed rehabilitates his former lawyer from his alcoholic haze, but complications arise when he falls for Weed's girlfriend.

5688214d94e177c052ca8fe1b12b86b7.overview: Two jobless Americans convince a prospector to travel to the mountains of Mexico with them in search of gold. But the hostile wilderness, local bandits, and greed all get in the way of their journey.
5688214d94e177c052ca8fe1b12b86b7.tagline: The nearer they get to their treasure, the farther they get from the law.

5689221c414495fe8cbdd5db1a036be0.overview: Leslie Zevo is a fun-loving inventor who must save his late father's toy factory from his evil uncle, Leland, a war-mongering general who rules the operation with an iron fist and builds weapons disguised as toys.
5689221c414495fe8cbdd5db1a036be0.tagline: Laughter is a state of mind.

56915c9d599c34972c42e1b7ad3ddc30.overview: A pushy, narcissistic filmmaker persuades a Phoenix family to let him and his crew film their everyday lives, in the manner of the ground-breaking PBS series "An American Family".

56bb6dcf6bcafe7b6b4be51d5ca022ce.overview: At an exclusive country club, an ambitious young caddy, Danny Noonan, eagerly pursues a caddy scholarship in hopes of attending college and, in turn, avoiding a job at the lumber yard. In order to succeed, he must first win the favour of the elitist Judge Smails, and then the caddy golf tournament which Smails sponsors.

56bdcf5ab2a6917ca39cbbd2f6d10caa.overview: Rose Morgan, who still lives with her mother, is a professor of Romantic Literature who desperately longs for passion in her life. Gregory Larkin, a mathematics professor, has been burned by passionate relationships and longs for a sexless union based on friendship and respect.
56bdcf5ab2a6917ca39cbbd2f6d10caa.tagline: A story about just how wrong two people can be before they can be right.
